mapper.select:
SELECT p.IPROM_NO AS "promNo", p.STITLE AS "title", p.SPROM_DT AS "promDate", p.SSTART_DT AS "startDate", p.ILAW_NO AS "lawNo", p.SURL AS "url", c.SNAME AS "cateNm", b.ORGNZT_NM AS "buseoNm", CASE WHEN p.SSTART_DT > TO_CHAR(LOCALTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "pendingYn" FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO b ON b.ORGNZT_ID = COALESCE(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(CAST(p.IBUSEO_NO AS text), 16, '0'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(p.STITLE, ' ', '')) = UPPER(REPLACE(#{keyword}, ' ', '')) THEN 0 WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(p.STITLE, ' ', '')) LIKE UPPER(REPLACE(#{keyword}, ' ', '')) || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.STITLE, p.IPROM_NO LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
mapper.sql:
SELECT PV.IPROM_NO AS "promNo", PR.STITLE AS "promTitle",
CASE WHEN PV.STITLE IS NOT NULL THEN PV.STITLE WHEN PV.SITEM IS NOT NULL AND (PV.SITEM ~ '^[0-9]+$') THEN '제' || CAST(PV.SITEM AS BIGINT) || '조' || CASE WHEN (COALESCE(PV.SSUB_ITEM, '0') ~ '^0*[1-9][0-9]*$') THEN '의' || CAST(PV.SSUB_ITEM AS BIGINT) ELSE '' END WHEN PV.SITEM IS NOT NULL THEN '제' || PV.SITEM || '조' ELSE '조문' END AS "hitTitle", PV.SITEM AS "item", PV.SSUB_ITEM AS "subItem", SUBSTRING(PV.SCONTENTS, 1, 160) AS "snippet", 1 AS "rank", 'BODY' AS "src" FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV, TB_PROM PR, cn WHERE PV.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO AND cn.ILAW_ID = PR.ILAW_ID
AND STRPOS(PV.SCONTENTS, #{keyword}) > 0 AND COALESCE(PV.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
AND PR.ILAW_NO <= cn.CUR_NO AND PR.ILAW_NO = ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV2, TB_PROM PR2 WHERE PV2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO AND PR2.ILAW_ID = PR.ILAW_ID AND PV2.SFULL_ITEM = PV.SFULL_ITEM AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= cn.CUR_NO )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROM cur WHERE cur.ILAW_ID = PR.ILAW_ID AND cur.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND cur.SDISP_YN = 'Y' )

SELECT cur.IPROM_NO AS "promNo", cur.STITLE AS "promTitle",
REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(s.SFULL_TITLE, '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '&', '&') AS "hitTitle", NULL AS "item", NULL AS "subItem", NULL AS "snippet", 0 AS "rank", 'TITLE' AS "src" FROM TB_SRC_STORED s JOIN TB_PROM cur ON cur.ILAW_ID = s.ILAW_ID AND cur.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND cur.SDISP_YN = 'Y' WHERE s.SFLAG = '조문' AND

FROM TB_DOCU d JOIN TB_PROM dp ON dp.IPROM_NO = d.IPROM_NO JOIN TB_PROM cur ON cur.ILAW_ID = dp.ILAW_ID AND cur.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND cur.SDISP_YN = 'Y' WHERE COALESCE(d.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(d.SGAEJUNG_TYPE, 'NEW') NOT LIKE 'NULLIFY%' AND ( OR ) AND dp.ILAW_NO <= cur.ILAW_NO AND dp.ILAW_NO = ( SELECT MAX(dp2.ILAW_NO) FROM TB_DOCU d2, TB_PROM dp2 WHERE d2.IPROM_NO = dp2.IPROM_NO AND dp2.ILAW_ID = dp.ILAW_ID AND d2.SITEM = d.SITEM AND dp2.ILAW_NO <= cur.ILAW_NO )
mapper.select:
SELECT d.IDOCU_NO AS "docuNo", d.STITLE AS "title", TRIM(d.SGRP_TITLE) AS "grpTitle", cur.IPROM_NO AS "promNo", cur.STITLE AS "promTitle"
ORDER BY cur.STITLE, d.SITEM LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT DISTINCT 'FILE' AS "kind", f.STITLE AS "title", NULL AS "snippet", cur.IPROM_NO AS "promNo", cur.STITLE AS "promTitle" FROM TB_PROM cur JOIN TB_PROM pr ON pr.ILAW_ID = cur.ILAW_ID JOIN TB_REL_VRSN v ON v.IPROM_NO = pr.IPROM_NO JOIN TB_REL_FILE f ON f.IRVRSN_NO = v.IRVRSN_NO WHERE cur.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND cur.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(f.SDEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND
UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'WORD' AS "kind", w.STITLE AS "title", SUBSTRING(w.SSEARCH_TEXT, 1, 160) AS "snippet", cur.IPROM_NO AS "promNo", cur.STITLE AS "promTitle" FROM TB_PROM cur JOIN TB_PROM pr ON pr.ILAW_ID = cur.ILAW_ID JOIN TB_REL_VRSN v ON v.IPROM_NO = pr.IPROM_NO JOIN TB_REL_WORD w ON w.IRVRSN_NO = v.IRVRSN_NO WHERE cur.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND cur.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(w.SDEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND ( OR ( w.SSEARCH_TEXT IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(w.SSEARCH_TEXT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ) )

FROM COMTNBBS a JOIN COMTNBBSMASTER m ON m.BBS_ID = a.BBS_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON b.ESNTL_ID = a.FRST_REGISTER_ID WHERE m.SEARCH_INCLD_AT = 'Y' AND m.USE_AT = 'Y' AND a.USE_AT = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a.SECRET_AT, 'N') != 'Y' AND a.BBS_ID IN #{bid} AND ( OR ( a.NTT_CN IS NOT NULL AND STRPOS(a.NTT_CN, #{keyword}) > 0 ) )

SELECT a.NTT_ID AS "nttId", a.BBS_ID AS "bbsId", m.BBS_NM AS "bbsNm", a.NTT_SJ AS "title", SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(SUBSTRING(a.NTT_CN, 1, 1000), '<[^>]*>|&[a-zA-Z#0-9]{2,8};', ' '), '[[:space:]]+', ' '), 1, 160) AS "snippet", TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "regDate", COALESCE(b.USER_NM, a.NTCR_NM) AS "regNm"
ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(a.NTT_SJ, ' ', '')) = UPPER(REPLACE(#{keyword}, ' ', '')) THEN 0 WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(a.NTT_SJ, ' ', '')) LIKE UPPER(REPLACE(#{keyword}, ' ', '')) || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC, a.NTT_ID DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STATS_KWD (ISKWD_NO, SKWD, ICNT, SINS_DT) VALUES (#{id}, #{kwd}, 1, TO_CHAR(LOCALTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
mapper.select: SELECT SKWD FROM ( SELECT k.SKWD, SUM(k.ICNT) AS CNT FROM TB_STATS_KWD k WHERE k.SINS_DT BETWEEN TO_CHAR(LOCALTIMESTAMP - make_interval(days => CAST(#{days} AS int)), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_CHAR(LOCALTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND k.SKWD IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(k.SKWD) != '' GROUP BY k.SKWD ORDER BY CNT DESC, k.SKWD ) X LIMIT #{topN}
